svg.aria-label: Experience. 2026 - present: Codepress, founder. Software house shipping fixed-scope products, audits, PoCs and enterprise RAG pilots, tests first and full code ownership for the client. 2026 - present: Witzard, technical collaboration. Senior technical advice and hands-on code on an AI portfolio-analytics platform (backtesting, VaR/CVaR, efficient frontier). Contributed the RSS-to-Gemini news pipeline and the white-label AI assistant. 2024 - present: KAIO, tech lead. Investor KYC on a schema-driven form engine, DocuSign subscription flows, Chainlink CCIP cross-chain integration, the encryption-key backup and rotation ceremony. Own QA (Playwright, Cucumber, Synpress), CI/CD and AWS monitoring. 2021 - 2023: TUI Musement, senior software engineer. Customer-facing tours and activities products for TUI Group. The team's E2E and monitoring approach (Playwright, Cucumber, Datadog), cloud-ops ambassador on AWS and Terraform. 2020: Nivaura, senior full stack engineer. Fintech microservices on AWS (Java/Spring, NestJS, Vue). Infrastructure, security and architecture decisions, CI/CD and ELK observability. 2015 - 2020: Addvalue, backend developer, then full stack engineer and front-end team lead (2018 - 2020). Web and batch applications for banking, financial and e-commerce clients (Java/Spring, Angular, React, Elasticsearch, PostgreSQL).
